stories.title: Field Range Benchmark Matrix & Diagnostic Mesh Logger
stories.description: Implement mesh diagnostic telemetry and field range benchmark harness in commonMain to measure RSSI, hop count, packet delivery ratio (PDR), and round-trip latency across 100m-500m outdoor environments.
acceptanceCriteria: MeshDiagnostics records real-time RSSI, hop count, duplicate drop counts, and PDR (Packet Delivery Ratio)
Diagnostics report generation computes link budget margin and latency distribution
Comprehensive unit tests verify statistics aggregation and sliding window metrics

stories.title: Highway Wind Noise & Helmet Intelligibility Tuning
stories.description: Implement specialized audio DSP tuning profiles in commonMain for motorcycle helmets at 80-120 km/h with adaptive high-pass wind rumble filter and voice-emphasis bandpass.
acceptanceCriteria: High-pass filter suppresses low-frequency wind buffeting (<300 Hz) by >18 dB
Voice formant emphasis boosts speech intelligibility band (1 kHz - 3.4 kHz)
Zero C/JNI or Java-only dependencies (pure Kotlin Multiplatform)

stories.title: Battery Drain Profiling & Screen-Off Power Optimization
stories.description: Implement battery and duty cycle telemetry manager in commonMain to monitor wake lock durations, BLE radio duty cycle, and ensure <30% drain over 4 continuous hours.
acceptanceCriteria: PowerProfiler tracks active vs idle radio duty cycles and estimated mAh burn rate
Detects runaway wake lock conditions and flags excessive battery drain (>7.5% per hour)

stories.title: v1.0 Production Release Readiness Sign-Off
stories.description: Configure release optimizations, ProGuard/R8 rules, verify release build variants for Android and iOS, and generate v1.0.0 release candidate manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: Android release build with ProGuard/R8 minification compiles cleanly
iOS framework compiles in Release configuration without dead-code stripping errors
v1.0.0 release candidate checklist signed off in docs/reports
